newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Less farmers took part in demonstrations against the government's agricultural policy on Tuesday than yesterday, but today they held a demonstration at the Parliament also.
- The Hungarian Employers' Association said it protested against government plans to amend labour laws without the consent of the association.
- The parliament began the discussion of a draft law on health care data management.
- Hungary has a substantial wheat flour surplus, which is pushing down flour prices, but Hungarian wheat is still too expensive for foreign buyers.
- A pipe bomb found in an office of SZDSZ, the smaller member party of the ruling coalition, was similar to the bomb which had exploded near an office of MSZP, the coalition's larger party.
